This is a Continuous Thread Story post, where anyone can contribute to the story so long as it pertains to the post they reply to.

The Rules are simple here:

  1. To start an adventure, make a post directly to the thread. Anything that pertains to Captain Kek and/or the USS Dank is up for grabs.

  2. To continue the story, reply to the last entry of the story and add the next section to that Adventure.

  3. Try to refrain from doubling up on replies to the story so as to prevent too many story arcs from occurring in the same adventure. Remember, you can always start your own Adventure for the crew of the USS Dank!

  4. If you really want to take an Adventure down a different path, make a new Reply to the part you're starting from and lead the post with [DIVERGENT]

  5. If you have Questions or Comments about the story, make a new post on the FreeWrite Subverse

Always remember to have fun here, and let the inspirations flow!
Captian Kek, and the Adventures of the USS Dank [Continuous Thread Stories]

"And so it begins..."

Captain Kek gazed upon his Starship as his Pod approached the vessel that was intended to take Humanity to the stars, in search of another planet that could sustain human life. It had taken the cooperation of the planet as a whole to achieve this conquest, despite the political opposition to the project. The truth is, if this ship had not been completed, Humanity may have died on Earth before it ever had the chance to reach the stars.

Admittedly, the USS Dank had required valuable resources that Earth couldn't afford to waste on frivolous projects, including a means to harvest resources from the Asteroid Belt and beyond. But it was a risk worth taking. For humanity to prosper, it would have to leave it's home.

Captain Kek boarded his new home, and made a beeline for the Helm, as he was expected to report to Admiral Meme to receive is new Mission aboard the Dank. The thoughts raced through his mind about the future of the ship, but was at the same time on guard. The production of the Dank had gone on without a hitch, which was highly unusual since the Dank Project had faced backlash. The project was deemed a reckless waste of time and effort by some on Earth, and that the financial aspect could have been spent on the people on Earth who needed the help rather than wasting time on a 'what if' in the stars. Perhaps humanity finally agreed on something?

BOOM The whole ship shuddered and reverberated with what sounded to be an explosion. Kek sprinted up the corridors to reach the helm and to contact HQ.

I do a classical piece that I should record video for. I think you'd like it. To do it, I have to take my hand off the neck, reach around and come in from the front, and fret with my thumb way back on the 3rd fret while my pinky stretches to the 11th fret. So, I don't have my thumb on the back of the neck, because my whole hand is in front of the fingerboard and is used to come in from that direction to fret properly.
